description: Vet creators for brand safety and price sponsorships: one trust score across a creator's whole cross-platform footprint.

interface.longDescription:
CreatorScore helps brands and agencies vet creators, influencers, and athletes for brand safety, and price sponsorships, without leaving ChatGPT.

Ask for a creator by name or handle and get their CreatorScore: a 1-100 trust score across their entire cross-platform footprint (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Twitch, LinkedIn, and more), with a 7-agent breakdown (content risk, brand safety, sentiment, authenticity, audience quality, community trust, ROI), the specific brand-safety risks found, always explained rather than just counted, and when they were last scored.

A CreatorScore is always a creator's whole online footprint: one unified score across all their platforms, never a single isolated account.

What you can do:
- Find a creator by name and confirm the right person
- Preview a creator's discovered footprint (free), then score it as one creator
- Vet or compare creators you already know (cached scores)
- See your roster: the creators already on your account, with risk flags
- Get a free, sourced fair-rate estimate for a sponsorship (OCRS)
- Share a public, no-login profile link

Transparent by design: the assistant tells you the credit cost before spending and never triggers fresh data collection without your confirmation. Finding creators, footprint previews, rate estimates, roster reads, and shareable links are free; scoring a creator uses one credit from your CreatorScore account (the whole footprint, any number of platforms).

Sign in with your CreatorScore account, no API key to paste. The plugin acts only as your account, using your existing permissions and credits. Credits and billing are managed on creatorscore.io, not in ChatGPT.

Shows the account name and credit balance. No purchase link or prices.
Returns ranked candidate footprints with linked platforms and last-scored date, and asks the user to confirm the right person. Free.

First returns a free preview of the discovered accounts and asks the user to confirm. Only after the user says yes does it state the 1-credit cost, start scoring, return a job id, and report the unified score with per-platform detail.

positive.prompt: Fair rate for a TikTok creator, 250k median views, fitness niche, tier-1 audience?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a fair rate, a negotiating range, and the breakdown behind it. Free.

negative.prompt: Just give me their TikTok-only score, I don't care about the other platforms.

negative.description: Bulk spend without confirmation: states the cost of 1 credit per creator and asks for explicit confirmation before scoring anything.
negative.prompt: Score all 40 creators on this list right now.

negative.description: Purchase request: explains credits are managed on creatorscore.io and buying is not available in ChatGPT; shows no prices or checkout links.

review.commerce_description: No purchases inside ChatGPT. Credits and billing are managed on creatorscore.io; the plugin shows no prices, plans, or checkout links.
